summary_en: 40,000 shares (2.21% of shares outstanding), up to ¥30.0M, executed via N-NET3 立会外取引 on 2026-08-06 at closing price ¥750/share on 2026-08-05. Results to be disclosed same day after market close.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-floor transaction (N-NET3)
translation_en_brief: Arkcore announced on 2026-08-05 a block acquisition of its own shares to be executed the following day. A major shareholder had indicated intent to sell its holdings; in response, the company decided to acquire up to 40,000 shares (2.21% of shares outstanding, ex-treasury) for a maximum of ¥30.0M via an off-floor transaction (N-NET3 立会外買付取引) on the Nagoya Stock Exchange. The purchase price was set at ¥750 per share, the closing price on 2026-08-05. Execution occurred on 2026-08-06 at 08:45 JST, with results to be disclosed after market close. The stated rationale was to mitigate market supply-demand shock and to pursue capital efficiency and enhanced shareholder returns through flexible capital allocation. The share count represents 2.21% of the 1,806,312 shares outstanding (excluding treasury) as of the announcement date.
